clips.text: You did not get replaced by AI. You got replaced by a checklist. How AI automation actually works.
Automation just means steps a machine follows without asking you first.
For fifty years, those steps were rules. If this, then that.
Rules break the moment real life looks slightly different from the example.
Now add a model. Something that reads a messy pile and guesses the sensible thing.
Set a goal. Give it tools. Check the result. Go again.
That loop is the automation. The model is only one part of it.
It is not one genius robot. It is a loop with a safety check bolted on.
And the check is where it fails. No check means no automation, just vibes.
Goal. Tools. Check. Repeat. So next time someone says the AI does it, ask where the check is.
